# M.J. Artel

> Independent colouring books for children aged 4–10 (any age can enjoy them), by M.J. Artel, with a free online Colouring Studio and free printable pages. Not related to Artel, the Chilean art-supply brand.

Author page on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/author/mjartel

## Books
- [The Wildwood Games](https://mjartel.fyi/wildwood-games-coloring-book/): the Foxes, Bears, Wolves and Eagles compete for forest fame, refereed by Snappy Snapsalot the snapping turtle. 37 pictures, each with a page of story; team-symbol and trophy activities. 76 pages, 8.625 × 8.75 in. "A Coloring Book" edition on Amazon.com; "A Colouring Book" on Amazon.ca and Amazon.co.uk.
- Translated editions of The Wildwood Games: German "Wildwald-Spiele Malbuch" (amazon.de/dp/B0GNZPRFY3), Spanish "Los Juegos de los Bosques Silvestres" (amazon.es/dp/B0GPK8VL65), French "Les Jeux des Bois Sauvages" (amazon.fr and amazon.ca/dp/B0GN39NTH3), Italian "I Giochi dei Boschi Selvaggi" (amazon.it/dp/B0GPBFSR5Q), Japanese "森の王国競技会ぬりえ" (amazon.co.jp/dp/B0GNMRH29Q).
- [Robot Coloring Book](https://mjartel.fyi/robot-coloring-book/): Scribbles the tiny robot loses his favourite colouring book and finds a friend. 30+ robots, 66 pages.
- Translated editions of the Robot Coloring Book: German "Roboter Malbuch" (amazon.de/dp/B0BQHB4YRY), Spanish "ROBOT Libro Para Colorear" (amazon.es/dp/B0BQ99KJ4M), French "ROBOT Livre de Coloriage" (amazon.fr and amazon.ca/dp/B0BQ9HSHBD), Italian "Robot Libro da Colorare" (amazon.it/dp/B0BQG4LHL8), Dutch "Robot Kleurboek" (amazon.nl/dp/B0BQZV6JZD), Japanese "ロボットの塗り絵" (amazon.co.jp/dp/B0BQY1ZWXY).
- [Cars Coloring Book](https://mjartel.fyi/cars-coloring-book/): 40 cars, one per page (classics, minis, race cars, campers), each backed by a patterned page so markers don't spoil the next drawing. 82 pages.

## Free
- [Colouring Studio](https://mjartel.fyi/color/): 16 pages from the books to colour in the browser with pencil crayons, wax crayons, watercolours, felt tips, alcohol markers and glitter pens. No account; works on phones and tablets.
- [Free colouring pages](https://mjartel.fyi/free-coloring-pages/): a six-page printable pack, free for home and classroom use.

## Ideas
- [Blog](https://mjartel.fyi/blog/): field day activities, teamwork activities and free animal, robot and car colouring pages for kids.
